headline: A photo of Japanese shop prices suggests Nvidia gaming graphics cards cost up to 41% more there than on Amazon in the US.
score_reason: Lowered by 1 from 5: the starting point is one social-media photo and the date is not given.
importance_line: It affects PC gamers and builders who may face higher prices, and the evidence is one Reddit photo plus the outlet's own comparison, so a wider trend is only suspected.
summary: Tom's Hardware reports that a Reddit user's photo of Japanese retail prices shows Nvidia RTX 50-series graphics cards priced 5.66% to 41.1% above Amazon US listings, with the RTX 5060 Ti 8GB showing the biggest gap in the outlet's own table. The outlet blames the memory-chip shortage and AI demand, hopes it is a local fluke, and warns that US prices could follow.
